description: Reruns of every thesis CV run (CUB exempt) whose selected epoch lies in the first four epochs after the warm-up (epoch -1 to 3 without warm-up); found by Thesis/review/patience_recovery_2026-10-19/finde_faelle.py. Rule: selection_delay_epochs 4 -- model selection starts at the fifth epoch with the SSL term (fifth training epoch without warm-up), patience counts normally from there. Each variant is the run's original resolved ablation variant (name: <original config>__<original variant>) plus its epoch cap, the normal patience (20, Semi-iNat 10) and the delay.
name: selection_delay_rerun_2026-10-19
